shared: Landscape-first visual region remains the dominant first read.
UNKNOWN / 未确认 is explicit on the recovery surface and is not rendered as NORMAL or OPEN.
The recovery surface states that live operation / route / weather / safety claims are not provided by this prototype.
Paper / human / digital-off fallback remains visible in recovery states.
A, B and C are materially different interaction mechanisms rather than style-only variants.

A_RETURN_RAIL.normal: At 520x844 the persistent rail is visually subordinate to landscape/content and its Return / Service action remains fully visible.
A_RETURN_RAIL.return: Recovery sheet renders with UNKNOWN fail-closed status and four fallback/service blocks.
A_RETURN_RAIL.mechanism_risk: Persistent chrome competes with landscape-first attention.

B_CONTEXT_BEACON.normal: At 520x844 the compact beacon remains visible while leaving more content area than A.
B_CONTEXT_BEACON.return: Recovery drawer renders with explicit no-pseudo-live wording and digital-off fallback.
B_CONTEXT_BEACON.mechanism_risk: Discoverability under stress/low attention requires representative-user evidence.

C_RETURN_MODE.normal: Explore state keeps optional content separate from return semantics.
C_RETURN_MODE.return_portrait: Return mode suppresses exploration content and renders UNKNOWN plus fallback/service relationships as the primary state.
C_RETURN_MODE.return_landscape: 844x390 capture is coherent; mode control, UNKNOWN state and four service/fallback blocks are simultaneously legible.
C_RETURN_MODE.mechanism_risk: Explicit mode switching adds a mode-entry/exit cognitive cost.

defect_and_repair.initial_observation: 390x844 screenshots appeared to crop right-side controls and initially suggested a mobile overflow defect.
defect_and_repair.diagnosis: The Windows headless Chromium invocation does not provide trustworthy true-390-CSS-pixel mobile emulation in this environment. A later 520x844 run with unique profiles and a write delay produced stable complete captures for all A/B/C normal and recovery states.
defensive_code_repair: return rail changed to width:100%; max-width:520px
defect_and_repair.repair_interpretation: The CSS hardening is retained because it is robust layout practice, but the original narrow screenshot crop is not counted as a proven product defect.
